query:
UPDATE menus
                        SET name        = COALESCE($1, name),
                            description = COALESCE($2, description),
                            is_active   = COALESCE($3, is_active),
                            permanent   = COALESCE($4, permanent),
                            updated_at  = NOW(),
                            updated_by  = $6
                        WHERE id = $5
                        RETURNING id
